section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), a 30-item instrument used to measure the multi-dimensional impact of sociocultural influences on body image. The text explains that participants completed the Malay version of the SATAQ-3, which consists of three dimensions in the Malay translation (compared to four in the English version), and notes that only the first two subscales were administered in the present study. Internal consistency coefficients (omega values) are reported for the subscales used.
